entities.summary: Mạc Thiên Tứ, also known as Mạc Thiên Tích or Mạc Tông, was a Vietnamese leader who ruled Hà Tiên from 1735 to 1771 and from 1773 to 1777. He was called Mo Shilin in Veritable Records of Qing dynasty.
